decisions.decision: Which training is the best fit for the person
decisions.whoDecides: The responding program staff; Angela describes routing staff based on their affiliation
decisions.decidesOn: Whether the person is health system staff, campus staff, or a member of the public or industry
decisions.basis: DES is meant for the general public and industry; Angela directs health system staff to Transformational Healthcare Team and campus staff to OSI

decisions.decision: Whether the attendee can complete registration
decisions.decidesOn: Whether the acknowledgement checkbox has been checked
decisions.basis: The attendee could register after checking the acknowledgement box
decisions.failurePath: The attendee emailed the OSI inbox after receiving an error

decisions.decision: Whether the session is an open-registration session or a department-requested session
decisions.basis: Tony says the process depends on whether it is open registration or department requested

decisions.decision: Which dates and delivery format to schedule
decisions.decidesOn: Their calendars, a planned six-week cadence, and alternating virtual and in-person delivery
decisions.basis: They meet, review calendars, and try to set dates through a six-month period or the end of the year

decisions.decision: Whether to add or remove people from the roster
decisions.decidesOn: Late cancellations and late adds identified about a day before the session
decisions.basis: Tony reviews the roster before the session

decisions.decision: Whether prior white belt or yellow belt training suffices as a prerequisite for Green Belt or Black Belt
decisions.decidesOn: Whether the person completed white belt or yellow belt through an online course, OSI, or DES
decisions.basis: Brad says they can progress without retaking it

decisions.stage: Receive the certificate and consider next steps
decisions.decision: Whether a participant is marked present or absent
decisions.basis: Tony updates UC Learning after the session
